title: Our Top 10 Stocks to Set It & Forget It!
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: Brian hosts (with Dividendology's Eli as collab partner) a '$50,000, 10 stocks, 25 years, no trading' forever-list challenge, premised on the stat that only ~4% of US stocks (1,000 of 26,000 since 1926) created all net market wealth. Brian's list, #10 to #1: Microsoft (28.7% 10-yr CAGR, Azure 20%+, $80B net cash, Office/AI downside protection), Alphabet (Search mid-teens growth, $198B revenue, Cloud 25-30%, Waymo underappreciated, $95B reserves vs regulatory risk), Amazon (AWS 17% to $29.3B, 25%/yr ex-COVID, ad/retail flywheel), Nvidia ($5B->$60B revenue 2016-24, 90% data-center GPU share, 70%+ gross margins), Visa (233B transactions/yr, 60%+ operating margins, 16 yrs of dividend hikes), MercadoLibre ('Latin America's Amazon'+fintech, 43% revenue CAGR 2021-24, 100M+ buyers of 450M adults), IONQ (pure-play quantum, trapped-ion 99.9% fidelity, 950+ patents, breakeven target 2030, asymmetric upside), Costco (16% 20-yr CAGR, Kirkland $3B->$86B, e-commerce only 3% of sales = upside), CrowdStrike ($4.4B ARR +22%, 80% subscription margins, >120% net retention), Palantir (first $1B quarter, $10B US Army deal, rule-of-40 score 94; analysts -16% downside but 'consistently wrong' - he keeps DCAing). Each gets a stated analyst 12-month upside (MSFT/AMZN/V ~18%, GOOGL ~10%, NVDA ~2%, MELI ~22%, IONQ ~20%, COST ~12%, CRWD ~14%, PLTR -16%). He then walks through Eli's moat/ROIC list (MSFT, Visa, Mastercard, ASML, Broadcom, Costco, Canadian National Railway, Waste Management, 'MLX' garbled, JPM) and Joseph Hogue's AI-growth list (Dell, Marvell, Super Micro, Symbotic highlighted). Calls: MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, V, MELI, IONQ, COST, CRWD, PLTR all BUY (Brian); Eli/Hogue lists are host-only. Note: 'Marcato Libre' = MercadoLibre; 'Whimo' = Waymo; 'MLX' unresolvable.
